caption.title: Caption
caption.description: Represents a single social media caption, quote, or photo status post with category and SEO metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the caption document

title.description: Short title or headline for the caption

text.description: The caption or status text in Bangla or English

category.description: Category ID such as islamic, motivational, attitude, romantic, sad, life, friendship

imageUrl.description: Direct image URL hosted on ImgBB or external image host

slug.description: URL-friendly unique slug for programmatic individual page indexing

tags.description: List of hashtags related to the caption

likes.description: Number of user likes or saves

metaTitle.description: Custom SEO meta title for Google search

published.description: Whether the caption is live and visible to visitors

/captions/{captionId}.description: Collection of all public captions and status items
